#Load the datasets
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
dds_mouse <- readRDS("/work/users/x/c/xczhou/Chlamydia/processed/dds_mouse.rds")

#Excluding M52_D4
dds_mouse_filtered <- dds_mouse[, !(colnames(dds_mouse) %in% c("M52_D4"))]

# Set reference levels
dds_mouse_filtered$group <- factor(dds_mouse_filtered$group,
                                   levels = c("Naive", "Vaccinated"))

dds_mouse_filtered$day <- factor(dds_mouse_filtered$day,
                                 levels = c("-2", "4", "6", "11"))

```



#Filter out low expression and low variance
```{r}
# Extract raw count matrix
raw_counts <- counts(dds_mouse_filtered)

# Filter bottom 25% by mean raw expression
gene_mean <- rowMeans(raw_counts)
expr_cutoff <- quantile(gene_mean, 0.25)
keep_expr <- gene_mean > expr_cutoff
dds_expr_filtered <- dds_mouse_filtered[keep_expr, ]


# VST on expression-filtered dds for variance filtering
dds_expr_filtered <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_expr_filtered)
vst_mat <- assay(vst(dds_expr_filtered, blind = TRUE))

# Filter bottom 25% by variance on VST matrix
gene_vars <- apply(vst_mat, 1, var)
var_cutoff <- quantile(gene_vars, 0.25)
keep_var <- gene_vars > var_cutoff


# Final filtered DESeqDataSet
dds_final <- dds_expr_filtered[keep_var, ]


# Subset by group
dds_naive <- dds_final[, dds_final$group == "Naive"]
dds_vacc  <- dds_final[, dds_final$group == "Vaccinated"]

# Drop unused factor levels
dds_naive$day <- droplevels(dds_naive$day)
dds_vacc$day  <- droplevels(dds_vacc$day)

# Design is now just day (no group needed since we're within one group)
design(dds_naive) <- ~ day
design(dds_vacc)  <- ~ day

# Run DESeq2 separately
dds_naive <- DESeq(dds_naive)
dds_vacc  <- DESeq(dds_vacc)

# Check result names
resultsNames(dds_naive)
resultsNames(dds_vacc)

# Extract results for each group
naive_d4  <- results(dds_naive, name = "day_4_vs_.2")
naive_d6  <- results(dds_naive, name = "day_6_vs_.2")
naive_d11 <- results(dds_naive, name = "day_11_vs_.2")

vacc_d4   <- results(dds_vacc, name = "day_4_vs_.2")
vacc_d6   <- results(dds_vacc, name = "day_6_vs_.2")
vacc_d11  <- results(dds_vacc, name = "day_11_vs_.2")

```
# Filtering summary
```{r}
# Number of genes before filtering
n_start <- nrow(dds_mouse_filtered)

# Number of genes after expression filtering
n_after_expr <- nrow(dds_expr_filtered)

# Number of genes after expression + variance filtering
n_final <- nrow(dds_final)

# Summary table
filter_summary <- data.frame(
  Step = c("Before filtering",
           "After low-expression filter",
           "After low-variance filter"),
  Genes_remaining = c(n_start, n_after_expr, n_final),
  Genes_filtered_out = c(0,
                         n_start - n_after_expr,
                         n_after_expr - n_final),
  Total_filtered_out_from_start = c(0,
                                    n_start - n_after_expr,
                                    n_start - n_final)
)

filter_summary
```



```{r}
# Count significant genes by group and day
count_sig <- function(res, padj_thresh = 0.05, lfc_thresh = NULL) {
  keep <- !is.na(res$padj) & res$padj < padj_thresh
  if (!is.null(lfc_thresh)) keep <- keep & abs(res$log2FoldChange) > lfc_thresh
  sum(keep)
}

thresholds <- list(
  c(padj = 0.05,  lfc = 1),
  c(padj = 0.01,  lfc = 1),
  c(padj = 0.01,  lfc = 1.5),
  c(padj = 0.001, lfc = 1),
  c(padj = 0.001, lfc = 1.5),
  c(padj = 0.001, lfc = 2)
)

results_list <- list(
  Naive_D4 = naive_d4, Naive_D6 = naive_d6, Naive_D11 = naive_d11,
  Vacc_D4  = vacc_d4,  Vacc_D6  = vacc_d6,  Vacc_D11  = vacc_d11
)

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(results_list), function(nm) {
  res <- results_list[[nm]]
  counts <- sapply(thresholds, function(t) count_sig(res, padj_thresh = t["padj"], lfc_thresh = t["lfc"]))
  names(counts) <- c("padj_0.05_lfc1", "padj_0.01_lfc1", "padj_0.01_lfc1.5",
                     "padj_0.001_lfc1", "padj_0.001_lfc1.5", "padj_0.001_lfc2")
  c(Comparison = nm, counts)
}))

print(as.data.frame(summary_df))
```

```{r}
combined_cutoff_summary <- function(res) {
  data.frame(
    padj_0.05_lfc1 = sum(!is.na(res$padj) &
                           res$padj < 0.05 &
                           abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1),
    
    padj_0.01_lfc1 = sum(!is.na(res$padj) &
                           res$padj < 0.01 &
                           abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1),
    
    padj_0.01_lfc1.5 = sum(!is.na(res$padj) &
                             res$padj < 0.01 &
                             abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1.5),
    
    padj_0.001_lfc1 = sum(!is.na(res$padj) &
                            res$padj < 0.001 &
                            abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1),
    
    padj_0.001_lfc1.5 = sum(!is.na(res$padj) &
                              res$padj < 0.001 &
                              abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 1.5),

        # FC > 4 or FC < 0.25    
    padj_0.001_lfc2 = sum(!is.na(res$padj) &
                            res$padj < 0.001 &
                            abs(res$log2FoldChange) > 2)
  )
}

combined_summary <- rbind(
  Day4_vs_DayMinus2 = combined_cutoff_summary(res_d4),
  Day6_vs_DayMinus2 = combined_cutoff_summary(res_d6),
  Day11_vs_DayMinus2 = combined_cutoff_summary(res_d11)
)

combined_summary
```

```{r}
get_up_down_genes <- function(res, padj_cutoff = 0.001, lfc_cutoff = 2) {
  
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res) %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    filter(!is.na(padj))
  
  up_genes <- res_df %>%
    filter(padj < padj_cutoff,
           log2FoldChange > lfc_cutoff) %>%
    arrange(padj)
  
  down_genes <- res_df %>%
    filter(padj < padj_cutoff,
           log2FoldChange < -lfc_cutoff) %>%
    arrange(padj)
  
  list(
    up = up_genes,
    down = down_genes
  )
}

naive_d4_genes_lfc2 <- get_up_down_genes(naive_d4, padj_cutoff = 0.001, lfc_cutoff = 2)
naive_d6_genes_lfc2 <- get_up_down_genes(naive_d6, padj_cutoff = 0.001, lfc_cutoff = 2)
naive_d11_genes_lfc2 <- get_up_down_genes(naive_d11, padj_cutoff = 0.001, lfc_cutoff = 2)

vacc_d4_genes_lfc2 <- get_up_down_genes(vacc_d4, padj_cutoff = 0.001, lfc_cutoff = 2)
vacc_d6_genes_lfc2 <- get_up_down_genes(vacc_d6, padj_cutoff = 0.001, lfc_cutoff = 2)
vacc_d11_genes_lfc2 <- get_up_down_genes(vacc_d11, padj_cutoff = 0.001, lfc_cutoff = 2)
```
